# Network/OnlineResource

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [OnlineResource.h](OnlineResource.h): A file an app needs from the network, kept on disk and fetched at most once: a fetch finds the local copy, asks the server whether it changed when the server gave it something to ask with, and downloads only when it has to. (declares `OnlineResource`)
- [OnlineResources.h](OnlineResources.h): The process-wide picture of every online resource: where they go, what is on disk, what is being fetched and how far along it is, and what failed. (declares `OnlineResources`)
